purpose: Human visual review of the eight generated cabinet images in set 2. The groups are visible wire-like AI-render differences for diagnostics only; they are not declared or intended electrical faults, a production acceptance result, or training data.

manual_rule.unit: one visually distinct connected dangling-conductor or exposed-copper visual-difference group
included: clearly detached or dangling white conductor
clearly exposed copper end on an otherwise loose blue conductor
excluded: ordinary AI text or component-detail regeneration
manual_rule.caveat: Raw images and the reference were the basis of the labels. Candidate output had been viewed earlier in this session, so this is a documented manual review rather than a strict double-blind study.
manual_rule.fault_truth_status: unknown: the AI generation prompt did not declare the intended fault count or locations. Do not use these visual groups as a hit-rate, miss-rate, false-positive-rate, or candidate-budget target.
